prompt: Import the component in imports/BrakeLightController.arxml. It needs 512 bytes of RAM. Add it to the Chassis composition and connect the brake subsystem's pPermittedBrakeAction to its rPermittedBrakeAction.
note: The export was made by SWCraft from a scratch copy of the bench with the component added (generate arxml --component BrakeLightController); its interface and types are the bench's own, so the import reuses them. A component export carries no memory budget, which is why the prompt states the RAM: without it check-model fails.
